name: cavemio-step-timeline
title: Step Timeline
author: Cavemio
description: An expanding step selector with timed progress and accessible manual navigation.

cavemio.usage:
import { StepTimeline } from "@/components/step-timeline";

<StepTimeline steps={steps} value={stage} onValueChange={setStage} />
cavemio.accessibility: Native buttons with pressed and expanded states, arrow/Home/End navigation, disabled support, and a pause control. Playback pauses on hover, keyboard focus, offscreen, and hidden tabs. Reduced motion disables timed progression and transitions.
cavemio.previewNote: An expanding stage selector with controlled selection and optional autoplay.

props.name: steps
props.description: Required. Nonempty steps with unique, stable IDs.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Optional. Called when the selection changes.

props.name: autoPlay
props.description: Optional. Opt in to timed progression.

props.name: duration
props.description: Optional. Duration of each timeline step in milliseconds.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Optional. Accessible name for the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional. Additional CSS classes for the root element.

props.name: style
props.description: Optional. Inline styles for the root element.
